# Columns of the `m.reference` datasets

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each section lists one dataset's columns in the order every verb returns them. **Supplied by** names the transports that fill a column; a column the serving transport does not fill is null. The wire-field columns name the Massive fields behind each column (`request` for a value the library fills from the request). The same descriptions appear in the web UI's column tooltips and in a query's `columns()`.

In a session with `unknown_symbols=dm.UnknownSymbols.WARN` (or `MASSIVE_UNKNOWN_SYMBOLS=warn`), `m.reference.tickers`, `m.reference.ticker_details`, `m.reference.related_companies`, and `m.snapshots` also have a `RawSymbol` String column, which holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. The tables below show the default session, without it.

<a id="tickers"></a>

## `m.reference.tickers`

Every ticker Massive supports, across asset classes, with its listing details.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST | `ticker` |
| `Active` | boolean | Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted. | REST | `active` |
| `BaseCurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST | `base_currency_name` |
| `BaseCurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST | `base_currency_symbol` |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). | REST | `cik` |
| `CompositeFigi` | String | The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST | `composite_figi` |
| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST | `currency_name` |
| `CurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST | `currency_symbol` |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. | REST | `delisted_utc` |
| `LastUpdatedUtc` | Instant | The information is accurate up to this time. | REST | `last_updated_utc` |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. | REST | `locale` |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. | REST | `market` |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. | REST | `name` |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. | REST | `primary_exchange` |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST | `share_class_figi` |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). | REST | `type` |

## `m.reference.ticker_details`

One ticker's company and listing details: address, branding, shares, and more.

Note that you must provide an API key when accessing this URL. See the "Authentication" section at the top of this page for more details. From the `branding` object: Provides URLs aiding in visual identification. | REST | `branding.icon_url` |
| `BrandingLogoUrl` | String | A link to this ticker's company's logo. Note that you must provide an API key when accessing this URL. See the "Authentication" section at the top of this page for more details. From the `branding` object: Provides URLs aiding in visual identification. | REST | `branding.logo_url` |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). | REST | `cik` |

| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST | `currency_name` |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. | REST | `delisted_utc` |
| `Description` | String | A description of the company and what they do/offer. | REST | `description` |

| `ListDate` | LocalDate | The date the security currently trading under this ticker was first publicly listed, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. If a corporate action replaces the security behind the ticker, such as American Depositary Shares being exchanged for ordinary shares under the same symbol, this is the new security's listing date. A move to a different exchange does not change it. Use the date parameter to get the value as of an earlier date. | REST | `list_date` |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. | REST | `locale` |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. | REST | `market` |
| `MarketCap` | double | The most recent close price of the ticker multiplied by weighted outstanding shares. | REST | `market_cap` |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. | REST | `name` |
| `PhoneNumber` | String | The phone number for the company behind this ticker. | REST | `phone_number` |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. | REST | `primary_exchange` |
| `RoundLot` | double | Round lot size of this security. | REST | `round_lot` |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST | `share_class_figi` |
| `ShareClassSharesOutstanding` | double | The recorded number of outstanding shares for this particular share class. | REST | `share_class_shares_outstanding` |
| `SicCode` | String | The standard industrial classification code for this ticker. For a list of SIC Codes, see the SEC's SIC Code List (https://www.sec.gov/info/edgar/siccodes.htm). | REST | `sic_code` |
| `SicDescription` | String | A description of this ticker's SIC code. | REST | `sic_description` |
| `TickerRoot` | String | The root of a specified ticker. For example, the root of BRK.A is BRK. | REST | `ticker_root` |
| `TickerSuffix` | String | The suffix of a specified ticker. For example, the suffix of BRK.A is A. | REST | `ticker_suffix` |
| `TotalEmployees` | double | The approximate number of employees for the company. | REST | `total_employees` |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). | REST | `type` |

The companies Massive relates to a ticker, from news and returns data, one row each.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## `m.reference.conditions`

The trade and quote condition codes, with what each means and how it updates bars.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Abbreviation` | String | A commonly-used abbreviation for this condition. | REST | `abbreviation` |
| `AssetClass` | String | An identifier for a group of similar financial instruments. | REST | `asset_class` |
| `DataTypes` | String | Data types that this condition applies to. | REST | `data_types` |
| `Description` | String | A short description of the semantics of this condition. | REST | `description` |
| `Exchange` | long | If present, mapping this condition from a Massive code to a SIP symbol depends on this attribute. In other words, data with this condition attached comes exclusively from the given exchange. | REST | `exchange` |
| `Id` | long | An identifier used by Massive for this condition. Unique per data type. | REST | `id` |
| `Legacy` | boolean | If true, this condition is from an old version of the SIPs' specs and no longer is used. Other conditions may or may not reuse the same symbol as this one. | REST | `legacy` |
| `Name` | String | The name of this condition. | REST | `name` |
| `SipMappingCta` | String | Condition code from the Consolidated Tape Association (CTA). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST | `sip_mapping.CTA` |
| `SipMappingOpra` | String | Condition code from the Options Price Reporting Authority (OPRA). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST | `sip_mapping.OPRA` |
| `SipMappingUtp` | String | Condition code from UTP Plan (UTP). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST | `sip_mapping.UTP` |
| `Type` | String | An identifier for a collection of related conditions. | REST | `type` |
| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesHighLow` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the high/low. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.consolidated` object: Describes aggregation rules on a consolidated (all exchanges) basis. | REST | `update_rules.consolidated.updates_high_low` |
| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesOpenClose` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the open/close. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.consolidated` object: Describes aggregation rules on a consolidated (all exchanges) basis. | REST | `update_rules.consolidated.updates_open_close` |
| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesVolume` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the volume. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.consolidated` object: Describes aggregation rules on a consolidated (all exchanges) basis. | REST | `update_rules.consolidated.updates_volume` |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesHighLow` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the high/low. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.market_center` object: Describes aggregation rules on a per-market-center basis. | REST | `update_rules.market_center.updates_high_low` |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesOpenClose` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the open/close. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.market_center` object: Describes aggregation rules on a per-market-center basis. | REST | `update_rules.market_center.updates_open_close` |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesVolume` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the volume. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.market_center` object: Describes aggregation rules on a per-market-center basis. | REST | `update_rules.market_center.updates_volume` |

<a id="snapshots"></a>

## `m.snapshots`

The current state of tickers of any asset classes, from Massive's unified snapshot.

Called as `m.snapshots`, a method of the session itself rather than of `m.reference`; its catalog record is `reference.snapshots`, so its columns are documented on this page.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the asset." | REST | `ticker` |
| `BreakEvenPrice` | double | The price of the underlying asset for the contract to break even. For a call, this value is (strike price + premium paid). For a put, this value is (strike price - premium paid). | REST | `break_even_price` |
| `DetailsContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.contract_type` |
| `DetailsExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.exercise_style` |
| `DetailsExpirationDate` | LocalDate | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.expiration_date` |
| `DetailsSharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.shares_per_contract` |
| `DetailsStrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.strike_price` |
